title: Numerical Claim Detection in Finance: A New Financial Dataset, Weak-Supervision Model, and Market Analysis

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating a document-level optimism measure by applying a fine-tuned financial sentiment analysis model (FinBERT) to extracted numerical 'in-claim' sentences, and evaluating this bias via empirical regression against market outcomes like Earnings Surprise and Cumulative Abnormal Returns (CAR).
